full_page.content:
1934, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NC. 5.
Page 168 Cont.
Jan 8 Ollie Keil - 42 - of North Street, Mich. - near Port huron - steel in eye 4 years ago - last 6 weeks infection.
9 Oscar Noteboom - 42 - operated on 4 weeks yesterday for appendicitis - now reported hopeless & gangreenous. Enrolled at 3:30 P.M. Wife & 3 small children depending on him. Jan. 10 - Reported "out of dan- ger ... Deo Gr.
9 Mrs. M. Wigins - 38 - Eyritis since baby br'n 4 weeks ago ... the 7th baby. Oldest boy 16 stop school ... only support of Fam. - all wept with him at giving mother Ist pay.
10 M. Siebert - 41 - in Rec. Hospital fears cancer - once virtuous ... till went to war.
Little Fred Alders. . Dan Larkin - 80 - dying now ... Baby swallowed .... can't
Page 169 Jan. 10 Mae Martin - 37 - non C. - breast removed - fears it coming back (as cancer)
Sage Family - 3 - Once well to do - very Charitable .... Mother stroke - rest trying.
Mrs. Theresa Jantz - 75 - knocked down Dec. 23 by Auto - badly broken up & in pain.
John J. Uller - 53 - some time discouraged - very conscientious & charitable - took man out of prison - made man of him - stole $3000.
Leo Howe - 19 - infection in hip socket 42 months ..... on crutches Dort R. Sherrill - 40 - non C. but good, sad however, he can not resist invitations to drink ... . Christian Sc'st .... .. friend.
15th Maureen Kay - 132 - St. Clair Shores, pneumonia two weeks, a week now since crisis, fluid still collects in lungs ...
16th Mother promised weekly communion if operation not necessary .... Child astonished doctors before might.
